newsitem.title: USA: Ajay extends expiration date for warrants.
newsitem.headline: Ajay extends expiration date for warrants.

text.p: Ajay Sports Inc said Monday its directors have extended the expiration date of the Ajay Sports publicly traded common stock warrants until December 31, 1997.
The warrants were originally set to expire on June 30, 1997.
Each warrant currently allows a holder to purchase one share of the common stock of Ajay Sports for $1.00 per share. The warrants trade under the symbol "AJAYW" on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.

Ajay Sports makes and markets Spalding golf bags, carts, gloves and accessories, Palm Springs Golf clubs, bags and accessories, and In-Motion casual living furniture, for the United States and select foreign markets.
